_comment: Arenas. At the start of a run you are asked which one; /scene lists them and switches. Each scene has: title; text (what the director and narrator read: name every feature here); place (how notes refer to it); ground / rough / slick (the plain floor, what a drag scrapes over, what a foot slips on); props (solid things to be thrown or driven into, or to lean on getting up); ambience; hazards; events. A HAZARD is a feature that does something when a fighter lands on it, is thrown, dragged, charged or pressed into it: 'words' are how it is recognised in a surface name; 'effects' are statuses with a chance and a length in beats (burned, poisoned, paralyzed, chilled, soaked, confused, flinched); 'break' is the chance it breaks under a charge or a held stream (an extra heavy hit, and she goes down with it); 'upright' means a fighter can end slumped sitting against it; 'cushion' makes any landing on it light. An EVENT is something the place does by itself, now and then (rules.json scene.event_chance per beat; never during a pin or a hold): 'who' is anyone, standing, down, or all; 'severity' and 'regions' are the hit it lands, if any; 'effects' as for hazards; 'weight' is how often compared with the scene's other events. Add your own scene by copying one. details: small things about the place (a sound, a smell, the light) that the narrator is offered one at a time, as background, the least recently used first; add your own to any scene.

sea cave.title: The flooded sea cave
sea cave.text: A flooded sea cave of rough grey stone. The floor is a wide central ledge of dry, gritty rock, ringed by ankle-deep pools and cut by one deep channel of cold water along the west wall. Near the water the stone is slick with algae; away from it, it is dry and harsh. A low ceiling hangs with short stalactites that drip steadily. Thick stalagmites rise around the edges of the ledge, and fallen boulders lie scattered along the east wall. Grey daylight filters in through a crack high in the east wall. The cave smells of salt and wet stone, and every sound echoes.
sea cave.ambience: dripping water, echoes, cold stone, the grey light, the smell of salt
details: a drip from the ceiling, counting
the echo coming back a moment late
the grey light from the crack in the east wall
the smell of salt and wet stone
the cold coming up out of the rock
the pools ringing the ledge, rippling from nothing
the channel along the west wall, black and still
grit shifting under a foot
a bead of water running down a stalagmite
the way sound has nowhere to go in here

waterfall gorge.title: The waterfall gorge
waterfall gorge.text: A narrow river gorge under a waterfall. The fighting ground is a shelf of dark, water-worn rock beside the plunge pool, green with moss and slick wherever the spray reaches. The fall itself comes down in a white column at the north end, loud enough to drown a shout, pounding the pool to foam. A jam of grey driftwood logs is wedged against the east bank, and a bar of loose river gravel runs along the south edge. Downstream the pool empties into rapids studded with half-sunk rocks. The gorge walls rise sheer and wet on both sides, and the light is green and shifting with mist.
waterfall gorge.ambience: the roar of the fall, drifting mist, moss underfoot, cold spray, green light
details: the roar of the fall, which never changes
mist drifting across in slow sheets
moss dark and soft on the rocks
cold spray settling on fur
the green light under the trees
the river pulling past, loud and brown
a wet leaf turning on an eddy
the smell of water on stone
the gorge walls sweating
a rainbow that comes and goes in the spray

hazards.about: tons of falling water: anyone driven under it is hammered, drenched and left dazed

power plant.title: The abandoned power plant
power plant.text: The turbine hall of an abandoned power plant. The floor is rusted steel grating over a flooded sump of black water, with solid concrete along the walls. A dead turbine in its steel housing fills the middle of the hall. Along the west wall runs a bank of steam pipes that still tick and hiss at their joints, and from the gantry overhead hang snapped power cables whose ends spit blue sparks. A catwalk with a corroded railing crosses the north end, a slick of spilled coolant shines on the concrete below it, and the control room's shattered window has left the east side littered with broken glass. Emergency lamps give a dim red light, and the air smells of ozone and rust.
power plant.ambience: the hiss of steam, sparks spitting, red emergency light, the smell of ozone and rust, the black water under the grating
details: steam hissing from a split pipe
a spark spitting somewhere overhead
the red emergency light, steady
the smell of ozone and rust
the black water under the grating
a loose panel ticking as it cools
the hum in the floor
a gauge with its needle fallen flat
condensation running down a duct
shadows with hard edges

caldera.title: The caldera vents
caldera.text: A shelf of black basalt inside a volcano's caldera. The rock is warm underfoot and cracked into rough plates. Steam vents breathe along the cracks, some in steady plumes and some in sudden bursts. Along the north edge a tongue of cooling lava has crusted over, dull black with red light showing through its seams, hot enough to scorch fur at a touch. Blades of black obsidian jut from the ground near the west side, tall basalt columns stand in a broken row to the east, and a hot spring steams in a hollow to the south beside beds of yellow sulfur crystal that give off an acrid, choking reek. The crater wall rises sheer and black behind it all. Fine ash drifts down, and the light is dim and orange.
props: the rim of the hot spring
caldera.ambience: heat rising from the rock, the hiss of vents, drifting ash, the reek of sulfur, the dull red glow
details: heat rising off the rock in a shimmer
a vent hissing, then stopping
ash drifting down, slow as snow
the reek of sulfur
the dull red glow at the edges of things
the rock ticking as it cools
air that is hard to breathe deep
a crust of yellow round a crack
the sky a dirty orange above the rim
warmth coming up through the soles of the feet

frozen lake.title: The frozen lake
frozen lake.text: A mountain lake frozen from shore to shore inside a ring of ice cliffs. At the center the ice is thick and blue, scored white by old cracks; toward the inlet at the north end it thins to a grey skin over black, moving water. Wind-carved pillars of ice stand here and there on the surface, a fringe of long icicles hangs under the overhang of the west cliff, deep snowdrifts are banked along the south shore, and a few frost-rimed boulders sit frozen into the lake's edge. The air is brutally cold and still, every breath smokes, and the ice creaks and booms under any weight.
frozen lake.ambience: the ice creaking and booming, smoking breath, the stillness, the blue light in the ice, the bite of the cold
details: the ice creaking, a long way off
a boom running under the surface
breath smoking in the air
the stillness between sounds
the blue light inside the ice
the cold biting at wet fur
snow squeaking under a foot
a white crack that was not there before
the shore a dark line far off
frost forming where breath lands

hazards.name: the icicles

hazards.name: an ice pillar

storm forest.title: The forest clearing in a storm
storm forest.text: A clearing among ancient trees, in the middle of a thunderstorm. Rain comes down in sheets and the ground is churned mud and leaf litter, laced with thick roots. On the north side stands an old oak split down the middle by lightning, its heartwood still smouldering and smoking in the rain. A bramble thicket closes the east side in a wall of thorns. In the grass to the south grows a wide ring of pale toadstools that puff clouds of spores when disturbed. A hollow, rotten log lies across the west side, and beyond it a creek runs brown and fast with the rain. Thunder rolls, the trees thrash overhead, and lightning makes everything white for an instant at a time.

thunder walking round the edge of the sky
branches thrashing overhead
the smell of wet earth and smoke

wreck.title: The wreck on the reef
wreck.text: The deck of a rusting freighter run aground on a reef, in a heavy swell. The steel deck is canted toward the port side, where waves break over the low rail and sheet across the plating. A cargo hatch gapes open amidships over a hold half full of dark seawater. The snapped derrick lies across the foredeck with its hook still swinging on a length of chain, the anchor chain runs in great rusted links along the starboard side, splintering wooden crates have slid into a heap against the deckhouse, and the rails and hull plates are crusted with barnacles as sharp as broken pottery. Everything is wet, salt-streaked and groaning as the swell works the hull.
wreck.ambience: the boom of waves on the hull, groaning steel, salt spray, the hook swinging on its chain, the grey sky

desert ruins.title: The ruins in the sandstorm
desert ruins.text: The courtyard of a ruined temple, half buried in the desert, with a sandstorm blowing over it. The ground is cracked flagstones drifted with sand. Sandstone pillars stand around the edge, some whole, some leaning, their blocks loose in their sockets. A toppled statue lies in three pieces across the middle. In the north corner the paving has fallen in and left a pit of soft, deep sand; in the south corner is a dry well with a low stone rim and a black shaft; and along the west wall a stand of tall spiny cactus has taken root in the rubble. The wind howls through the gaps, the air is brown with flying grit, and the sun is a dim coin.
desert ruins.ambience: the howl of the wind, grit hissing on stone, the dim brown light, heat coming off the flagstones, sand in every breath

crystal mine.title: The crystal mine
crystal mine.text: A gallery deep in an abandoned mine. Rusted cart rails run down the middle of a rock floor littered with rubble, and a derailed iron ore cart lies on its side across them. Rotting timber props hold up the roof, some already bowed. Clusters of quartz crystal as long as a forelimb bristle from the walls and catch what light there is. At the east end a slope of loose scree leads up to a collapsed tunnel, and at the west end a shaft has flooded to the brim with still, icy, black water. Dust hangs in the air, the roof ticks and settles, and a pale glow comes from the crystals themselves.
crystal mine.ambience: the roof ticking and settling, dust hanging in the air, the pale glow of the crystals, dripping from the flooded shaft, dead silence between sounds

clock tower.title: The clock tower works
clock tower.text: The machine room of a great clock tower, behind the clock face. The floor is worn oak planking around a well where the pendulum swings: a brass weight the size of a boulder on a long iron rod, sweeping from one side of the room to the other and back, slow and unstoppable. Trains of brass gears taller than a fighter turn along the north wall, their teeth meshing with a steady clack. The great bell hangs in an open frame at the east end. Loops of drive chain hang from the beams, a steam whistle for the hour stands by the west wall with its valve hissing, and the clock face itself is a wall of pale glass with the light of the city behind it.
clock tower.ambience: the clack of gears, the slow sweep of the pendulum, the tick that fills the room, oil and brass, light through the clock face
